units.he: וּמִכָּל־ הָ֠חַי מִֽכָּל־ בָּשָׂ֞ר שְׁנַ֧יִם מִכֹּ֛ל תָּבִ֥יא אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֖ה לְהַחֲיֹ֣ת אִתָּ֑ךְ זָכָ֥ר וּנְקֵבָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ׃
units.en: And from every living creature, from all flesh, you shall bring two of each into the ark, to keep them alive with you; they shall be male and female.

units.he: מֵהָע֣וֹף לְמִינֵ֗הוּ וּמִן־ הַבְּהֵמָה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ מִכֹּ֛ל רֶ֥מֶשׂ הֽ͏ָאֲדָמָ֖ה לְמִינֵ֑הוּ שְׁנַ֧יִם מִכֹּ֛ל יָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ לְהֽ͏ַחֲיֽוֹת׃
units.en: From the birds according to their kinds, and from the livestock according to its kind, from every creature moving along the ground according to its kind, two of each shall come to you, to keep them alive.

units.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח־ לְךָ֗ מִכָּל־ מֽ͏ַאֲכָל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֽ͏ֵאָכֵ֔ל וְאָסַפְתָּ֖ אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְהָיָ֥ה לְךָ֛ וְלָהֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָֽה׃
units.en: And you, take for yourself some of every food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; it shall be food for you and for them.

units.he: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ נֹ֑חַ כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃
units.en: And Noah did so; according to everything that G-d commanded him, so he did.

units.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ לְנֹ֔חַ בֹּֽא־ אַתָּ֥ה וְכָל־ בֵּיתְךָ֖ אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֑ה כִּֽי־ אֹתְךָ֥ רָאִ֛יתִי צַדִּ֥יק לְפָנַ֖י בַּדּ֥וֹר הַזֶּֽה׃
units.en: And Hashem said to Noah: Come, you and all your household, into the ark, for I have seen you to be righteous before Me in this generation.

units.he: וּמִכָּל דְּחַי מִכָּל בִּשְׂרָא תְּרֵין מִכֹּלָא תָּעֵיל לְתֵבוֹתָא לְקַיָּמָא עִמָּךְ דְּכַר וְנָקְבָּא יְהוֹן:
units.en: And from everything that lives, from all flesh, you shall bring two of each into the ark, to preserve them with you; they shall be male and female.

units.he: מֵעוֹפָא לִזְנוֹהִי וּמִן בְּעִירָא לִזְנַהּ וּמִכֹּל רִחֲשָׁא דְאַרְעָא לִזְנוֹהִי תְּרֵין מִכֹּלָּא יַעֲלוּן לְוָתָךְ לְקַיָּמָא:
units.en: From the birds according to their kinds, and from the livestock according to its kind, and from every creature moving along the earth according to its kind, two of each shall come to you, to preserve them.

units.he: וְאַתְּ סַב לָךְ מִכָּל מֵיכַל דִּמִתְאֲכֵל וְתִכְנוֹשׁ לְוָתָךְ וִיהֵי לָךְ וּלְהוֹן לְמֵיכָל:
units.en: And you, take for yourself some of every food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; it shall be for you and for them to eat.

units.he: וַעֲבַד נֹח כְּכֹל דִּי פַקֵּיד יָתֵיהּ יְיָ כֵּן עֲבָד:
units.en: And Noah did so; according to everything that Hashem commanded him, so he did.

units.he: וַאֲמַר יְיָ לְנֹחַ עוּל אַתְּ וְכָל אֱנַשׁ בֵּיתָךְ לְתֵבוֹתָא אֲרֵי יָתָךְ חֲזֵיתִי זַכַּאי קֳדָמַי בְּדָרָא הָדֵין:
units.en: And Hashem said to Noah: Enter, you and every person of your household, into the ark, for I have seen you to be righteous before Me in this generation.

units.he: מֵעֹ֤צֶר וּמִמִּשְׁפָּט֙ לֻקָּ֔ח וְאֶת־ דּוֹר֖וֹ מִ֣י יְשׂוֹחֵ֑חַ כִּ֤י נִגְזַר֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֔ים מִפֶּ֥שַׁע עַמִּ֖י נֶ֥גַע לָֽמוֹ׃
units.en: From restraint and judgment he was taken away; and who will speak of his generation? For he was cut off from the land of the living; because of the transgression of my people, a stroke was upon [him/them].

units.he: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת־ רְשָׁעִים֙ קִבְר֔וֹ וְאֶת־ עָשִׁ֖יר בְּמֹתָ֑יו עַ֚ל לֹא־ חָמָ֣ס עָשָׂ֔ה וְלֹ֥א מִרְמָ֖ה בְּפִֽיו׃
units.en: [One] assigned his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his deaths, although he had done no violence and there was no deceit in his mouth.

units.he: וַיהוָ֞ה חָפֵ֤ץ דַּכְּאוֹ֙ הֶֽחֱלִ֔י אִם־ תָּשִׂ֤ים אָשָׁם֙ נַפְשׁ֔וֹ יִרְאֶ֥ה זֶ֖רַע יַאֲרִ֣יךְ יָמִ֑ים וְחֵ֥פֶץ יְהוָ֖ה בְּיָד֥וֹ יִצְלָֽח׃
units.en: But Hashem desired to crush him; He made [him] ill. If you make his life a guilt-offering, he shall see offspring and prolong his days, and Hashem's desire shall prosper through his hand.

units.he: מֵעֲמַ֤ל נַפְשׁוֹ֙ יִרְאֶ֣ה יִשְׂבָּ֔ע בְּדַעְתּ֗וֹ יַצְדִּ֥יק צַדִּ֛יק עַבְדִּ֖י לָֽרַבִּ֑ים וַעֲוֺנֹתָ֖ם ה֥וּא יִסְבֹּֽל׃
units.en: From the toil of his life he shall see and be satisfied. By his knowledge My righteous servant shall vindicate the many, and their iniquities he shall bear.

units.he: לָכֵ֞ן אֲחַלֶּק־ ל֣וֹ בָרַבִּ֗ים וְאֶת־ עֲצוּמִים֮ יְחַלֵּ֣ק שָׁלָל֒ תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶעֱרָ֤ה לַמָּ֙וֶת֙ נַפְשׁ֔וֹ וְאֶת־ פֹּשְׁעִ֖ים נִמְנָ֑ה וְהוּא֙ חֵטְא־ רַבִּ֣ים נָשָׂ֔א וְלַפֹּשְׁעִ֖ים יַפְגִּֽיעַ׃
units.en: Therefore I shall allot him a portion among the many, and with the mighty he shall divide spoil, because he poured out his life to death and was numbered with transgressors; yet he bore the sin of many and intercedes for transgressors.

units.he: מִיסוּרִין וּמִפּוּרְעֲנוּת יְקָרֵיב גַלְוָתָנָא וּפְרִישָׁן דְיִתְעַבְדָן לָנָא בְּיוֹמוֹהִי מַן יִכּוּל לְאִשְׁתְּעָאָה אֲרֵי יַעְדֵי שׁוּלְטָן עַמְמַיָא מֵאַרְעָא דְיִשְׂרָאֵל חוֹבִין דְחָבוּ עַמִי עַד לְוַתְהוֹן יִמְטוֹ:
units.en: From afflictions and punishment he will bring our exiles near; and who can recount the wonders that will be performed for us in his days? For he will remove the nations' dominion from the land of Israel; the sins that my people committed will reach them.

units.he: וְיִמְסַר יַת רַשִׁיעַיָא לְגֵהִנָם וְיַת עֲתִּירֵי נִכְסַיָא דַאֲנַסוּ בְּמוֹתָא דְאָבַדְנָא בְּדִיל דְלָא יִתְקַיְמוּן עָבְדֵי חֶטְאָה וְלָא יְמַלְלוּן נִכְלִין בְּפוּמְהוֹן:
units.en: And he will hand over the wicked to Gehinnom, and those wealthy in possessions who acted violently to a death of destruction, so that those who commit sin will not endure, nor speak deceits with their mouths.

units.he: וּמִן קֳדָם יְיָ הֲוָת רַעֲוָא לְמִצְרַף וּלְדַכָּאָה יַת שְׁאָרָא דְעַמֵהּ בְּדִיל לְנַקָאָה מֵחוֹבִין נַפְשֵׁיהוֹן יֶחֱזוּן בְּמַלְכוּת מְשִׁיחֵיהוֹן יִסְגוּן בְּנִין וּבְנָן יוֹרְכוּן יוֹמִין וְעָבְדֵי אוֹרַיְתָא דַייָ בִּרְעוּתֵהּ יִצְלְחוּן:
units.en: And it was the will of יְיָ to refine and purify the remnant of His people, in order to cleanse their souls of sins. They will see the kingdom of their anointed one; sons and daughters will multiply; they will have long days; and those who perform the Torah of דַייָ will prosper by His will.

units.he: מִשִׁעְבּוּד עַמְמַיָא יְשֵׁיזֵיב נַפְשְׁהוֹן יֶחֱזוּן בְּפּוּרְעֲנוּת סַנְאֵיהוֹן יִסְבְּעוּן מִבִּזַת מַלְכֵיהוֹן בְּחוּכְמְתֵהּ יְזַכֵּי זַכָּאִין בְּדִיל לְשַׁעְבָּדָא סַגִיאִין לְאוֹרַיְתָא וְעַל חוֹבֵיהוֹן הוּא יִבְעֵי:
units.en: He will rescue their souls from servitude to the nations. They will see the punishment of their enemies; they will be satisfied with the spoil of their kings. Through his wisdom he will vindicate the righteous, in order to bring many into obedience to the Torah; and concerning their sins he will pray.

units.he: בְּכֵן אֲפַלֵיג לֵיהּ בִּזַת עַמְמִין סַגִיאִין וְיַת נִכְסֵי כְּרַכִּין תַּקִיפִין יְפַלֵג עֲדָאָה חֲלַף דִמְסַר לְמוֹתָא נַפְשֵׁהּ וְיַת מְרוֹדַיָא שַׁעְבַּד לְאוֹרַיְתָא וְהוּא עַל חוֹבִין סַגִיאִין יִבְעֵי וְלִמְרוֹדַיָא יִשְׁתְּבֵיק בְּדִילֵהּ:
units.en: Therefore I shall allot to him the spoil of many peoples; and he will apportion the property of fortified cities as spoil, in return for having handed over his life to death and brought the rebellious into obedience to the Torah. And he will pray concerning many sins, and the rebellious will be forgiven on his account.

units.he: אִם־ תְּבַקְשֶׁ֥נָּה כַכָּ֑סֶף וְֽכַמַּטְמוֹנִ֥ים תַּחְפְּשֶֽׂנָּה׃
units.en: If you seek it as silver, and search for it as for hidden treasures,

units.he: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת אֱלֹהִ֣ים תִּמְצָֽא׃
units.en: then you shall understand the fear of Hashem, and find the knowledge of G-d.

units.he: כִּֽי־ יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה מִ֝פִּ֗יו דַּ֣עַת וּתְבוּנָֽה׃
units.en: For Hashem gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.

units.he: יִצְפֹּ֣ן לַ֭יְשָׁרִים תּוּשִׁיָּ֑ה מָ֝גֵ֗ן לְהֹ֣לְכֵי תֹֽם׃
units.en: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright, a shield for those who walk in integrity,

units.he: לִ֭נְצֹר אָרְח֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְדֶ֖רֶךְ חֲסִידָ֣יו יִשְׁמֹֽר׃
units.en: to guard the paths of justice; and He preserves the way of His faithful ones.

units.he: וְתִבְעֵי הֵיךְ סִימָא הֵיךְ סִימָתָא תִצְבְּיָהּ:
units.en: And [if] you seek it as silver and desire it as treasures—

units.he: הֵידֵין תִּתְבַּיֵן דְחַלְתֵּיהּ דֶאֱלָהָא וִידִיעֲתָא מִן קֳדָם אֱלָהָא תִשְׁכָּח:
units.en: Then you will understand reverence for דֶאֱלָהָא [God], and you will find knowledge from before אֱלָהָא [God].

units.he: מְטוּל דֶאֱלָהָא יָהַב חָכְמְתָא מִן פּוּמֵיהּ יְדִיעֲתָא וּבְיוּנָא:
units.en: For דֶאֱלָהָא [God] gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.

units.he: יִטְשֵׁי לִתְרִיצֵי שִׁבְהוֹר וּמְסַיֵעַ לְאִילֵן דִמְהַלְכִין בְּלָא מוּם:
units.en: He stores up splendor for the upright, and helps those who walk without blemish.

units.he: לְמִנְטוֹר אָרְחָתָא דְדִינָא וְאָרְחָתָא דְצַדִיקִין נִנְטַר:
units.en: To guard the paths of judgment; and the paths of the righteous He will guard.

units.he: כֵּיצַד אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בְעוֹלָמוֹ. שְׁנֵי אַחִים, וּמֵת אֶחָד מֵהֶם, וְנוֹלַד לָהֶן אָח, וְאַחַר כָּךְ יִבֵּם הַשֵּׁנִי אֶת אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו, וָמֵת, הָרִאשׁוֹנָה יוֹצֵאת מִשּׁוּם אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בְעוֹלָמוֹ, וְהַשְּׁנִיָּה מִשּׁוּם צָרָתָהּ. עָשָׂה בָהּ מַאֲמָר וָמֵת, הַשְּׁנִיָּה חוֹלֶצֶת וְלֹא מִתְיַבֶּמֶת:
units.en: What is the case of the wife of a brother who did not live at the same time as he did? There were two brothers [A and B], and one of them [A] died; a brother [C] was born to them, and afterward the second brother [B] took his brother's wife in levirate marriage and died. The first wife goes free because she is the wife of a brother who did not live at the same time as [C], and the second because she is her co-wife. [In the alternative case, B] performed a preliminary levirate betrothal with her and died: the second wife undergoes levirate release and does not enter levirate marriage.

units.he: שְׁנֵי אַחִים וּמֵת אֶחָד מֵהֶן, וְיִבֵּם הַשֵּׁנִי אֶת אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו, וְאַחַר כָּךְ נוֹלַד לָהֶן אָח, וָמֵת, הָרִאשׁוֹנָה יוֹצֵאת מִשּׁוּם אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בְעוֹלָמוֹ, וְהַשְּׁנִיָּה מִשּׁוּם צָרָתָהּ. עָשָׂה בָהּ מַאֲמָר, וָמֵת, הַשְּׁנִיָּה חוֹלֶצֶת וְלֹא מִתְיַבֶּמֶת. רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר, מְיַבֵּם לְאֵיזוֹ מֵהֶן שֶׁיִּרְצֶה, אוֹ חוֹלֵץ לְאֵיזוֹ מֵהֶן שֶׁיִּרְצֶה:
units.en: There were two brothers [A and B], and one of them [A] died; the second [B] took his brother's wife in levirate marriage, and afterward a brother [C] was born to them; then [B] died. The first wife goes free because she is the wife of a brother who did not live at the same time as [C], and the second because she is her co-wife. [In the alternative case, B] performed a preliminary levirate betrothal with her and died: the second wife undergoes levirate release and does not enter levirate marriage. Rabbi Shimon says: He takes whichever of them he wishes in levirate marriage, or performs levirate release with whichever of them he wishes.

units.he: כְּלָל אָמְרוּ בַיְבָמָה. כָּל שֶׁהִיא אִסּוּר עֶרְוָה, לֹא חוֹלֶצֶת וְלֹא מִתְיַבֶּמֶת. אִסּוּרָהּ אִסּוּר מִצְוָה, וְאִסּוּר קְדֻשָּׁה, חוֹלֶצֶת וְלֹא מִתְיַבֶּמֶת. אֲחוֹתָהּ שֶׁהִיא יְבִמְתָּהּ, חוֹלֶצֶת אוֹ מִתְיַבֶּמֶת:
units.en: They stated a general rule concerning a widow subject to the levirate bond: Wherever she is forbidden by a prohibited sexual relationship, she neither undergoes levirate release nor enters levirate marriage. If her prohibition is a “commandment prohibition” or a “holiness prohibition,” she undergoes levirate release but does not enter levirate marriage. Her sister, who is [also] his widow subject to the levirate bond, undergoes levirate release or enters levirate marriage.

units.he: אִסּוּר מִצְוָה, שְׁנִיּוֹת מִדִּבְרֵי סוֹפְרִים. אִסּוּר קְדֻשָּׁה, אַלְמָנָה לְכֹהֵן גָּדוֹל, גְּרוּשָׁה וַחֲלוּצָה לְכֹהֵן הֶדְיוֹט, מַמְזֶרֶת וּנְתִינָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל, וּבַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְנָתִין וּמַמְזֵר:
units.en: A “commandment prohibition” means secondary prohibited relationships established by the Sages. A “holiness prohibition” means a widow for a High Priest; a divorced woman or a woman who has undergone levirate release for an ordinary priest; a woman of the ממזרת or נתינה lineage category for an Israelite; and an Israelite woman for a man of the נתין or ממזר lineage category.

units.he: מִי שֶׁיֶּשׁ לוֹ אָח מִכָּל מָקוֹם, זוֹקֵק אֶת אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו לְיִבּוּם, וְאָחִיו לְכָל דָּבָר, חוּץ מִמִּי שֶׁיֶּשׁ לוֹ מִן הַשִּׁפְחָה וּמִן הַנָּכְרִית. מִי שֶׁיֶּשׁ לוֹ בֵּן מִכָּל מָקוֹם, פּוֹטֵר אֵשֶׁת אָבִיו מִן הַיִּבּוּם, וְחַיָּב עַל מַכָּתוֹ וְעַל קִלְלָתוֹ, וּבְנוֹ הוּא לְכָל דָּבָר, חוּץ מִמִּי שֶׁיֶּשׁ לוֹ מִן הַשִּׁפְחָה וּמִן הַנָּכְרִית:
units.en: A man who has a brother of any status: [that brother] binds his brother's wife to levirate marriage and is his brother for every matter, except for a brother born from a slave woman or a non-Jewish woman. A man who has a son of any status: [that son] exempts his father's wife from levirate marriage, is liable for striking him and for cursing him, and is his son for every matter, except for one born to him from a slave woman or a non-Jewish woman.

units.he: מִי שֶׁקִּדֵּשׁ אַחַת מִשְּׁתֵּי אֲחָיוֹת וְאֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ אֵיזוֹ מֵהֶן קִדֵּשׁ, נוֹתֵן גֵּט לָזוֹ וְגֵט לָזוֹ. מֵת, וְלוֹ אָח אֶחָד, חוֹלֵץ לִשְׁתֵּיהֶן. הָיוּ לוֹ שְׁנַיִם, אֶחָד חוֹלֵץ וְאֶחָד מְיַבֵּם. קָדְמוּ וְכָנְסוּ, אֵין מוֹצִיאִין מִיָּדָם:
units.en: A man who betrothed one of two sisters and does not know which of them he betrothed gives a bill of divorce to this one and a bill of divorce to that one. [Alternatively, if] he died [before divorcing them] and had one brother, that brother performs levirate release with both. If he had two brothers, one performs levirate release and the other takes [the other sister] in levirate marriage. If they went ahead and married [the sisters], the women are not taken away from them.

units.he: שְׁנַיִם שֶׁקִּדְּשׁוּ שְׁתֵּי אֲחָיוֹת, זֶה אֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ אֵיזוֹ קִדֵּשׁ, וְזֶה אֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ אֵיזוֹ קִדֵּשׁ, זֶה נוֹתֵן שְׁנֵי גִטִּין, וְזֶה נוֹתֵן שְׁנֵי גִטִּין. מֵתוּ, לָזֶה אָח, וְלָזֶה אָח, זֶה חוֹלֵץ לִשְׁתֵּיהֶן, וְזֶה חוֹלֵץ לִשְׁתֵּיהֶן. לָזֶה אֶחָד וְלָזֶה שְׁנַיִם, הַיָּחִיד חוֹלֵץ לִשְׁתֵּיהֶן, וְהַשְּׁנַיִם, אֶחָד חוֹלֵץ וְאֶחָד מְיַבֵּם, קָדְמוּ וְכָנְסוּ, אֵין מוֹצִיאִין מִיָּדָם. לָזֶה שְׁנַיִם וְלָזֶה שְׁנַיִם, אָחִיו שֶׁל זֶה חוֹלֵץ לְאַחַת, וְאָחִיו שֶׁל זֶה חוֹלֵץ לְאַחַת, אָחִיו שֶׁל זֶה מְיַבֵּם חֲלוּצָתוֹ שֶׁל זֶה, וְאָחִיו שֶׁל זֶה מְיַבֵּם חֲלוּצָתוֹ שֶׁל זֶה. קָדְמוּ שְׁנַיִם וְחָלְצוּ, לֹא יְיַבְּמוּ הַשְּׁנַיִם, אֶלָּא אֶחָד חוֹלֵץ וְאֶחָד מְיַבֵּם. קָדְמוּ וְכָנְסוּ, אֵין מוֹצִיאִין מִיָּדָם:
units.en: Two men [A and B, who are not brothers] betrothed two sisters; this one does not know which he betrothed, and that one does not know which he betrothed. This one gives two bills of divorce, and that one gives two bills of divorce. [Alternatively, if both] died [before divorcing the women], and this one had one brother and that one had one brother, this brother performs levirate release with both, and that brother performs levirate release with both. If this one [A] had one brother and that one [B] had two, the sole brother performs levirate release with both; of the two, one performs levirate release and the other takes [the other sister] in levirate marriage. If they went ahead and married [after the sole brother's releases], the women are not taken away from them. If this one [A] had two brothers and that one [B] had two, a brother of this one [A1] performs levirate release with one sister, and a brother of that one [B1] performs levirate release with the other; the [other] brother of this one [A2] takes in levirate marriage the woman released by that one [B1], and the [other] brother of that one [B2] takes in levirate marriage the woman released by this one [A1]. If two [brothers of the same deceased man] went ahead and performed levirate release, the [other] two shall not both take [the sisters] in levirate marriage; rather, one performs levirate release and one takes [the other sister] in levirate marriage. If they went ahead and married [after the first pair's releases], the women are not taken away from them.

units.he: מִצְוָה בַגָּדוֹל לְיַבֵּם. וְאִם קָדַם הַקָּטָן, זָכָה. הַנִּטְעָן עַל הַשִּׁפְחָה וְנִשְׁתַּחְרְרָה, אוֹ עַל הַנָּכְרִית וְנִתְגַּיְּרָה, הֲרֵי זֶה לֹא יִכְנוֹס. וְאִם כָּנַס אֵין מוֹצִיאִין מִיָּדוֹ. הַנִּטְעָן עַל אֵשֶׁת אִישׁ, וְהוֹצִיאוּהָ מִתַּחַת יָדוֹ, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁכָּנַס, יוֹצִיא:
units.en: The commandment of levirate marriage rests on the eldest brother. If the younger went first, he has acquired [the levirate marriage]. A man suspected of relations with a slave woman who was subsequently freed, or with a non-Jewish woman who subsequently converted, shall not marry her; if he married her, she is not taken away from him. A man suspected of relations with a married woman, whom they removed from her husband's marriage: even if he married her, he must divorce her.

units.he: הַמֵּבִיא גֵט מִמְּדִינַת הַיָּם, וְאָמַר בְּפָנַי נִכְתַּב וּבְפָנַי נֶחְתַּם, לֹא יִשָּׂא אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ. מֵת, הֲרַגְתִּיו, הֲרַגְנוּהוּ, לֹא יִשָּׂא אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ. רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר, הֲרַגְתִּיו, לֹא תִנָּשֵׂא אִשְׁתּוֹ. הֲרַגְנוּהוּ, תִּנָּשֵׂא אִשְׁתּוֹ:
units.en: One who brings a bill of divorce from overseas and says, “It was written in my presence and signed in my presence,” shall not marry [the sender's] wife. [One who says of a husband,] “He died,” “I killed him,” or “We killed him,” shall not marry his wife. Rabbi Yehudah says: [If he says,] “I killed him,” his wife shall not remarry; [if he says,] “We killed him,” his wife may remarry.

units.he: הֶחָכָם שֶׁאָסַר אֶת הָאִשָּׁה בְּנֶדֶר עַל בַּעְלָהּ, הֲרֵי זֶה לֹא יִשָּׂאֶנָּה. מֵאֲנָה, אוֹ שֶׁחָלְצָה בְפָנָיו, יִשָּׂאֶנָּה, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא בֵית דִּין. וְכֻלָּן שֶׁהָיוּ לָהֶם נָשִׁים, וָמֵתוּ, מֻתָּרוֹת לִנָּשֵׂא לָהֶם. וְכֻלָּן שֶׁנִּשְּׂאוּ לַאֲחֵרִים וְנִתְגָּרְשׁוּ אוֹ שֶׁנִּתְאַלְמְנוּ, מֻתָּרוֹת לִנָּשֵׂא לָהֶן. וְכֻלָּן מֻתָּרוֹת לִבְנֵיהֶם אוֹ לַאֲחֵיהֶן:
units.en: A sage who, on account of a vow, prohibited a woman to her husband shall not marry her. If she refused [a minor's marriage] or underwent levirate release before him, he may marry her, because he is [acting as part of] a court. In all these cases, if the men had wives and [those wives later] died, the women may marry them. And in all these cases, if the women married other men and were divorced or widowed, they may marry these men. And in all these cases, the women may marry the men's sons or brothers.

units.he: הָעוֹקֵר שְׁתָלִים מִתּוֹךְ שֶׁלּוֹ וְנָטַע לְתוֹךְ שֶׁלּוֹ, פָּטוּר. לָקַח בִּמְחֻבָּר לַקַּרְקַע, פָּטוּר. לָקַט לִשְׁלֹחַ לַחֲבֵרוֹ, פָּטוּר. רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן עֲזַרְיָה אוֹמֵר, אִם יֵשׁ כַּיּוֹצֵא בָהֶם נִמְכָּרִים בַּשּׁוּק, הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ חַיָּבִין:
units.en: One who uproots seedlings from his own [land] and replants them in his own [land] is exempt [from tithes]. If he bought them while they were attached to the ground, he is exempt. If he gathered them to send to his fellow, he is exempt. Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah says: If others like them are sold in the market, these are liable [to tithes].

units.he: הָעוֹקֵר לֶפֶת וּצְנוֹנוֹת מִתּוֹךְ שֶׁלּוֹ וְנוֹטֵעַ לְתוֹךְ שֶׁלּוֹ לְזֶרַע, חַיָּב, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא גָּרְנָן. בְּצָלִים, מִשֶּׁהִשְׁרִישׁוּ בָעֲלִיָּה, טָהֲרוּ מִלְּטַמֵּא. נָפְלָה עֲלֵיהֶם מַפֹּלֶת וְהֵם מְגֻלִּים, הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ כִּנְטוּעִים בַּשָּׂדֶה:
units.en: One who uproots turnips and radishes from his own [land] and replants them in his own [land] for seed is liable [to tithes], because this is their threshing-floor stage [of completion]. Onions, once they have taken root in the upper room, have become pure from imparting impurity. If fallen debris covered them while they remain exposed [at their leaves], they are like plants planted in the field.

units.he: לֹא יִמְכֹּר אָדָם אֶת פֵּרוֹתָיו מִשֶׁבָּאוּ לְעוֹנַת הַמַּעַשְׂרוֹת לְמִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ נֶאֱמָן עַל הַמַּעַשְׂרוֹת, וְלֹא בַשְּׁבִיעִית לְמִי שֶׁהוּא חָשׁוּד עַל הַשְּׁבִיעִית. וְאִם בִּכְּרוּ, נוֹטֵל אֶת הַבַּכּוּרוֹת וּמוֹכֵר אֶת הַשְּׁאָר:
units.en: A person shall not sell his produce, once it has reached the stage for tithes, to one who is not reliable concerning tithes; nor, in the seventh year, to one suspected concerning [the laws of] the seventh year. If some have ripened early, he takes away the early-ripened produce and sells the rest.

units.he: לֹא יִמְכֹּר אָדָם אֶת תִּבְנוֹ וְאֶת גִּפְתּוֹ וְאֶת זַגָּיו לְמִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ נֶאֱמָן עַל הַמַּעַשְׂרוֹת, לְהוֹצִיא מֵהֶן מַשְׁקִין. וְאִם הוֹצִיא, חַיָּב בַּמַּעַשְׂרוֹת וּפָטוּר מִן הַתְּרוּמָה, שֶׁהַתּוֹרֵם, בְּלִבּוֹ עַל הַקְּטוּעִים, עַל הַצְּדָדִים וְעַל מַה שֶּׁבְּתוֹךְ הַתֶּבֶן:
units.en: A person shall not sell his straw, his olive pomace, or his grape skins to one who is not reliable concerning tithes, [the latter two] for extracting liquids from them. If he extracted [the liquids], he is liable for tithes but exempt from the priestly portion, because one who separates the priestly portion has in mind the broken-off ears, the sides [of the heap], and what is within the straw.

units.he: הַלּוֹקֵחַ שְׂדֵה יָרָק בְּסוּרְיָא, אִם עַד שֶׁלֹּא בָא לְעוֹנַת הַמַּעַשְׂרוֹת, חַיָּב. וּמִשֶּׁבָּא לְעוֹנַת הַמַּעַשְׂרוֹת, פָּטוּר, וְלוֹקֵט כְּדַרְכּוֹ וְהוֹלֵךְ. רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר, אַף יִשְׂכֹּר פּוֹעֲלִים וִילַקֵּט. אָמַר רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל, בַּמֶּה דְבָרִים אֲמוּרִים, בִּזְמַן שֶׁקָּנָה קַרְקַע, אֲבָל בִּזְמַן שֶׁלֹּא קָנָה קַרְקַע, אִם עַד שֶׁלֹּא בָא לְעוֹנַת הַמַּעַשְׂרוֹת, פָּטוּר. רַבִּי אוֹמֵר, אַף לְפִי חֶשְׁבּוֹן:
units.en: One who buys a field of vegetables in Syria: if [he buys it] before [the crop] has reached the stage for tithes, he is liable. If [he buys it] after it has reached the stage for tithes, he is exempt, and may go on gathering in his usual manner. Rabbi Yehudah says: He may even hire laborers and gather. Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel said: When are these words said? When he purchased the land; but when he did not purchase the land, if [he buys the crop] before it has reached the stage for tithes, he is exempt. Rabbi says: Even proportionately [he is liable].

units.he: הַמְתַמֵּד וְנָתַן מַיִם בַּמִּדָּה וּמָצָא כְדֵי מִדָּתוֹ, פָּטוּר. רַבִּי יְהוּדָה מְחַיֵּב. מָצָא יוֹתֵר עַל כְּדֵי מִדָּתוֹ, מוֹצִיא עָלָיו מִמָּקוֹם אַחֵר לְפִי חֶשְׁבּוֹן:
units.en: One who makes a steeped wine drink, having put in a measured quantity of water and found the same quantity, is exempt [from tithes]. Rabbi Yehudah makes him liable. If he found more than the quantity he put in, he separates [tithes] for it from elsewhere, proportionately.

units.he: חוֹרֵי הַנְּמָלִים שֶׁלָּנוּ בְצַד הָעֲרֵמָה הַחַיֶּבֶת, הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ חַיָּבִים, שֶׁיָּדוּעַ שֶׁמִּדָּבָר הַגָּמוּר הָיוּ גּוֹרְרִין כָּל הַלָּיְלָה:
units.en: Ant holes [whose ants] spent the night beside a heap liable [to tithes]: these [stored grains] are liable, because it is known that they were dragging from produce whose processing was completed throughout the night.

units.he: שׁוּם בַּעַל בֶּכִי, וּבָצָל שֶׁל רִכְפָּא, וּגְרִיסִין הַקִּילְקִין, וְהָעֲדָשִׁים הַמִּצְרִיּוֹת, רַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹמֵר, אַף הַקַּרְקָס, רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר אַף הַקּוּטְנִים, פְּטוּרִים מִן הַמַּעַשְׂרוֹת, וְנִלְקָחִין מִכָּל אָדָם בַּשְּׁבִיעִית. זֶרַע לוּף הָעֶלְיוֹן, זֶרַע כְּרֵשִׁים, זֶרַע בְּצָלִים, זֶרַע לֶפֶת וּצְנוֹנוֹת, וּשְׁאָר זֵרְעוֹנֵי גִנָּה שֶׁאֵינָן נֶאֱכָלִים, פְּטוּרִים מִן הַמַּעַשְׂרוֹת, וְנִלְקָחִין מִכָּל אָדָם בַּשְּׁבִיעִית, שֶׁאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֲבִיהֶן תְּרוּמָה, הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ יֵאָכֵלוּ:
units.en: Garlic of the בַּעַל בֶּכִי variety, onions from רִכְפָּא, split beans from קִילְקִין, and Egyptian lentils—Rabbi Meir says: Also קַרְקָס; Rabbi Yose says: Also קוּטְנִים—are exempt from tithes and may be bought from anyone in the seventh year. Seed of the upper לוּף, leek seed, onion seed, turnip and radish seed, and the other garden seeds that are not eaten are exempt from tithes and may be bought from anyone in the seventh year, for even though their parent [seed] is a priestly portion, these [growths] may be eaten.

reference.he: זוהר, חלק א, סא ע״ב–סב ע״א; שלושת הקטעים המדויקים שאושרו לקריאת היום
reference.en: Zohar, volume I, 61b–62a; the three exact spans approved for today's reading

units.he: רבי יצחק הוה שכיח קמיה דרבי שמעון, א"ל האי קרא (דקאמרי) דכתיב ותשחת הארץ
units.en: Rabbi Yitzchak was often in Rabbi Shimon's presence. He said to him: This verse (that they say), which is written, “And the earth became corrupt

units.he: לפני האלהי"ם, אי בני נשא חטאן ארעא במה, א"ל בגין דכתיב כי השחית כל בשר את דרכו כמה דאתמר, כגוונא דא (ויקרא יח כה) ותטמא הארץ ואפקוד עונה עליה, אלא ואי תימא אי בני נשא חטאן ארעא במה, אלא עיקרא דארעא בני נשא אינון, ואינון מחבלין ארעא והיא אתחבלת, וקרא אוכח, דכתיב וירא אלהי"ם את הארץ והנה נשחתה, כי השחית כל בשר את דרכו על הארץ. תא חזי כל חטאוי דבר נש, כלהו חבלותא דיליה תליין בתשובה, וחטאה דאושיד זרעא על ארעא ומחבלא ארחיה ואפיק זרעא על ארעא, מחבל ליה ומחבל ארעא, ועליה כתיב (ירמיה ב כב) נכתם עונך לפני, וכתיב ביה (תהלים ה ה) כי לא אל חפץ רשע אתה לא יגורך רע, בר בתשובה סגי, וכתיב (בראשית לח ז) ויהי ער בכור יהודה רע בעיני יהו"ה וימיתהו יהו"ה, והא אתמר. א"ל אמאי דאין קב"ה עלמא במיא, ולא באשא ולא במלה אחרא, א"ל רזא הוא, דהא אינון חבילו ארחייהו, בגין דמיין עלאין ומיין תתאין לא אתחברו כדקא יאות, מה אינון חבילו ארחייהו, כגוונא דא מיין דכורין ונוקבין לא אתחברו, ועל דא אתדנו במיא
units.en: before G-d”—if human beings sinned, in what [did] the earth [sin]? He said to him: Because it is written, “For all flesh had corrupted its way,” as has been stated; in the same manner, “And the earth became defiled, and I visited its iniquity upon it” (Leviticus 18:25). But if you say: If human beings sinned, in what [did] the earth [sin]? Rather, human beings are the earth's principal [inhabitants]; they corrupt the earth, and it becomes corrupted. And the verse proves it, for it is written, “And G-d saw the earth, and behold, it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted its way upon the earth.” Come and see: All a person's sins—all his acts of corruption—depend on repentance. But the sin of one who spills seed upon the earth, corrupts his way, and brings forth seed upon the earth corrupts him and corrupts the earth. Of him it is written, “Your iniquity is stained before Me” (Jeremiah 2:22), and concerning him it is written, “For You are not a G-d who desires wickedness; evil shall not dwell with You” (Psalms 5:5)—except through great repentance. And it is written, “And Er, Judah's firstborn, was evil in Hashem's eyes, and Hashem put him to death” (Genesis 38:7); this has already been stated. He said to him: Why does the Holy One, blessed be He, judge the world by water, and not by fire or by another thing? He said to him: It is a mystery, for they corrupted their ways, because the upper waters and the lower waters did not join as is fitting. Just as they corrupted their ways, so the masculine and feminine waters did not join; and for this they were judged by water

units.he: כמה דאינון חבו, ומיין הוו רתיחן ופשטו משכא מנייהו, כמה דחבילו ארחייהו במיין רתיחן. דינא לקבל דינא, הה"ד נבקעו כל מעינות תהום רבה, דא מיין תתאין, וארובות השמים נפתחו, דא מיין עלאין מיין עלאין ותתאין.
units.en: in accordance with the way they sinned. The waters were boiling and stripped the skin from them, in accordance with the way they had corrupted their ways through boiling waters. Judgment corresponding to judgment: this is what is written, “All the springs of the great deep burst open”—these are the lower waters—“and the windows of heaven opened”—these are the upper waters: upper waters and lower waters.

units.he: מִכֹּ֣ל ׀ הַבְּהֵמָ֣ה הַטְּהוֹרָ֗ה תִּֽקַּח־ לְךָ֛ שִׁבְעָ֥ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וּמִן־ הַבְּהֵמָ֡ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א טְהֹרָ֥ה הִ֛וא שְׁנַ֖יִם אִ֥ישׁ וְאִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
units.en: From every clean animal, take for yourself seven by seven, a male and its mate; and from the animals that are not clean, two, a male and its mate.
meaningNotes: The number seven is repeated, followed by the pairing of a male and its mate.
displayMeaningNotes: The number seven is repeated, followed by the pairing of a male and its mate.

units.he: גַּ֣ם מֵע֧וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם שִׁבְעָ֥ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה זָכָ֣ר וּנְקֵבָ֑ה לְחַיּ֥וֹת זֶ֖רַע עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י כָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
units.en: Also from the birds of the heavens, seven by seven, male and female, to keep offspring alive over the face of the whole earth.

units.he: כִּי֩ לְיָמִ֨ים ע֜וֹד שִׁבְעָ֗ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מַמְטִ֣יר עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה וּמָחִ֗יתִי אֶֽת־ כָּל־ הַיְקוּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הֽ͏ָאֲדָמָֽה׃
units.en: For in seven more days I will bring rain upon the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe away every living thing that I made from the face of the ground.

units.he: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ נֹ֑חַ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖הוּ יְהוָֽה׃
units.en: Noach did everything that the LORD commanded him.

units.he: וְנֹ֕חַ בֶּן־ שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וְהַמַּבּ֣וּל הָיָ֔ה מַ֖יִם עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
units.en: Noach was six hundred years old when the flood came as water upon the earth.

units.he: וַיָּ֣בֹא נֹ֗חַ וּ֠בָנָיו וְאִשְׁתּ֧וֹ וּנְשֵֽׁי־ בָנָ֛יו אִתּ֖וֹ אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֑ה מִפְּנֵ֖י מֵ֥י הַמַּבּֽוּל׃
units.en: Noach, his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him entered the ark because of the floodwaters.

units.he: מִכֹּל בְּעִירָא דַכְיָא תִּסַּב לָךְ שַׁבְעָא שַׁבְעָא דְּכַר וְנָקְבָּא וּמִן בְּעִירָא דִּלָא (אִיתָהָא) דַכְיָא הִיא תְּרֵין דְּכַר וְנָקְבָּא:
units.en: From every clean animal, take for yourself seven by seven, male and female; and from the animals that are not clean, two, male and female.
meaningNotes: The parenthetical אִיתָהָא supplies “is” in the negative clean-animal clause; it does not add another class of animal.
displayMeaningNotes: The parenthetical אִיתָהָא supplies “is” in the negative clean-animal clause; it does not add another class of animal.

units.he: אַף מֵעוֹפָא דִשְׁמַיָּא שַׁבְעָא שַׁבְעָא דְּכַר וְנָקְבָּא לְקַיָּמָא זַרְעָא עַל אַפֵּי כָל אַרְעָא:
units.en: Also from the birds of the heavens, seven by seven, male and female, to preserve offspring over the face of the whole earth.

units.he: אֲרֵי לִזְמַן יוֹמִין עוֹד שַׁבְעָא אֲנָא מָחֵת מִטְרָא עַל אַרְעָא אַרְבְּעִין יְמָמִין וְאַרְבְּעִין לֵילָוָן וְאֶמְחֵי יָת כָּל יְקוּמָא דִי עַבְדַת מֵעַל אַפֵּי אַרְעָא:
units.en: For at the appointed time, in seven more days, I will send rain down upon the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe away every living thing that I made from the face of the earth.

units.he: וַעֲבַד נֹחַ כְּכֹל דִּי פַקְּדֵיהּ יְיָ:
units.en: Noach did everything that the LORD commanded him.

units.he: וְנֹחַ בַּר שִׁתְּ מְאָה שְׁנִין וְטוֹפָנָא הֲוָה מַיָּא עַל אַרְעָא:
units.en: Noach was six hundred years old when the flood came as water upon the earth.

units.he: וְעָאל נֹחַ וּבְנוֹהִי וְאִתְּתֵיהּ וּנְשֵׁי בְנוֹהִי עִמֵּיהּ לְתֵבוֹתָא מִן קֳדָם מֵי טוֹפָנָא:
units.en: Noach, his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him entered the ark because of the floodwaters.

units.he: רָנִּ֥י עֲקָרָ֖ה לֹ֣א יָלָ֑דָה פִּצְחִ֨י רִנָּ֤ה וְצַהֲלִי֙ לֹא־ חָ֔לָה כִּֽי־ רַבִּ֧ים בְּֽנֵי־ שׁוֹמֵמָ֛ה מִבְּנֵ֥י בְעוּלָ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
units.en: Sing joyfully, barren one who has not given birth! Break into song and cry out, you who have not been in labor! For the children of the desolate one are more numerous than the children of the married woman, says the LORD.
meaningNotes: The passage addresses the restored city or community through the image of a woman.
displayMeaningNotes: The passage addresses the restored city or community through the image of a woman.

units.he: הַרְחִ֣יבִי ׀ מְק֣וֹם אָהֳלֵ֗ךְ וִירִיע֧וֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתַ֛יִךְ יַטּ֖וּ אַל־ תַּחְשֹׂ֑כִי הַאֲרִ֙יכִי֙ מֵֽיתָרַ֔יִךְ וִיתֵדֹתַ֖יִךְ חַזֵּֽקִי׃
units.en: Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your dwellings; do not hold back. Lengthen your cords and strengthen your pegs.

units.he: כִּי־ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹ֖אול תִּפְרֹ֑צִי וְזַרְעֵךְ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם יִירָ֔שׁ וְעָרִ֥ים נְשַׁמּ֖וֹת יוֹשִֽׁיבוּ׃
units.en: For you will spread out to the right and to the left; your offspring will possess nations and settle desolate cities.

units.he: אַל־ תִּֽירְאִי֙ כִּי־ לֹ֣א תֵב֔וֹשִׁי וְאַל־ תִּכָּלְמִ֖י כִּ֣י לֹ֣א תַחְפִּ֑ירִי כִּ֣י בֹ֤שֶׁת עֲלוּמַ֙יִךְ֙ תִּשְׁכָּ֔חִי וְחֶרְפַּ֥ת אַלְמְנוּתַ֖יִךְ לֹ֥א תִזְכְּרִי־ עֽוֹד׃
units.en: Do not fear, for you will not be ashamed; do not be humiliated, for you will not be disgraced. You will forget the shame of your youth, and remember the reproach of your widowhood no more.

units.he: כִּ֤י בֹעֲלַ֙יִךְ֙ עֹשַׂ֔יִךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ וְגֹֽאֲלֵךְ֙ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י כָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ יִקָּרֵֽא׃
units.en: For your husband is your Maker; the LORD of Hosts is His name. Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel; He will be called God of all the earth.
meaningNotes: “Husband” and “Maker” have plural grammatical forms but share the singular Divine referent, the LORD of Hosts.
displayMeaningNotes: “Husband” and “Maker” have plural grammatical forms but share the singular Divine referent, the LORD of Hosts.

units.he: כִּֽי־ כְאִשָּׁ֧ה עֲזוּבָ֛ה וַעֲצ֥וּבַת ר֖וּחַ קְרָאָ֣ךְ יְהוָ֑ה וְאֵ֧שֶׁת נְעוּרִ֛ים כִּ֥י תִמָּאֵ֖ס אָמַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃
units.en: For the LORD has called you like a wife abandoned and grieved in spirit, like a wife of youth when she is rejected, says your God.

units.he: שַׁבַּחִי יְרוּשְׁלֶם דַהֲוַת כְּאִתָּא עֲקָרָה דְלָא יְלֵידַת בּוּעִי תוּשְׁבַּחְתָּא וְדוּצִי דַהֲוָת כְּאִתָּא דְלָא עֲדִיאַת אֲרֵי סַגִיאִין יְהוֹן בְּנֵי יְרוּשְׁלֶם צְדִיתָא מִבְּנֵי כְרַכָּא יְתִיבְתָּא אֲמַר יְיָ:
units.en: Offer praise, Jerusalem, which was like a barren woman who had not given birth! Pour forth praise and rejoice, you who were like a woman who had not conceived! For the children of desolate Jerusalem will be more numerous than the children of the inhabited city, says the LORD.

units.he: אַפְתִּי אֲתַר בֵּית מֵישְׁרָךְ וּמִקִרְוֵי אַרְעִיךְ יָתְבֵי לָא תִמְנְעִין אַסְגָא עַם מַשִׁרְיָתִיךְ וְשִׁלְטוֹנָיִךְ תַּקִיפִי:
units.en: Enlarge the place of your dwelling, and let people settle in the cities of your land; do not hold back. Increase the people of your camps and strengthen your rulers.
meaningNotes: The Targum understands the tent’s cords and pegs through the images of camps and rulers.
displayMeaningNotes: The Targum understands the tent’s cords and pegs through the images of camps and rulers.

units.he: אֲרֵי לְדָרוֹמָא וּלְצִפּוּנָא תִּתְקְפִין וּבְנָךְ עַמְמִין יֵירְתוּן וְקִרְוִין דְצַדְיָן יֵיתְבוּן:
units.en: For you will grow strong to the south and to the north; your children will possess nations and settle cities that are desolate.

units.he: לָא תִדְחֲלִין אֲרֵי לָא תִבְהֲתִין וְלָא תִתְכַּנְעִין אֲרֵי לָא תִתְכַּלְמִין אֲרֵי בַהֲתַת עוּלֵמוּתִיךְ תִּתְנְשִׁין וְחִיסוּדֵי אַרְמְלוּתִיךְ לָא תִדְכְּרִין עוֹד:
units.en: Do not fear, for you will not be ashamed; do not be humbled, for you will not be disgraced. You will forget the shame of your youth, and remember the reproaches of your widowhood no more.

units.he: אֲרֵי מָרִיךְ דְעַבְדִיךְ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת שְׁמֵהּ וּפָרְקִיךְ קַדִישָׁא דְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֱלָהּ כָּל אַרְעָא יִתְקְרֵי:
units.en: For your Master who made you—the LORD of Hosts is His name—and your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, will be called God of all the earth.

units.he: אֲרֵי כְאִתָּא שְׁבִיקָא וְעָיְקַת רוּחַ עַרְעָךְ שְׁכִנְתָּא דַייָ וּכְאִתַּת עוּלֵמִין דְאִתְרַחֲקַת אֲמַר אֱלָהָיִךְ:
units.en: For the Divine Presence of the LORD has encountered you like a woman abandoned and grieved in spirit, and like a wife of youth who had been kept at a distance, says your God.

units.he: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין צֶ֣דֶק וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מֵישָׁרִ֗ים כָּל־ מַעְגַּל־ טֽוֹב׃
units.en: Then you will understand righteousness, justice, and uprightness—every good path.
meaningNotes: “Then” continues the outcome of the conditional pursuit of wisdom in 2:1–8.
displayMeaningNotes: “Then” continues the outcome of the conditional pursuit of wisdom in 2:1–8.

units.he: כִּֽי־ תָב֣וֹא חָכְמָ֣ה בְלִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝דַ֗עַת לְֽנַפְשְׁךָ֥ יִנְעָֽם׃
units.en: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

units.he: מְ֭זִמָּה תִּשְׁמֹ֥ר עָלֶ֗יךָ תְּבוּנָ֥ה תִנְצְרֶֽכָּה׃
units.en: Discretion will watch over you; understanding will guard you,

units.he: לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ רָ֑ע מֵ֝אִ֗ישׁ מְדַבֵּ֥ר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃
units.en: to rescue you from the way of evil, from the man who speaks perverse things,

units.he: הַ֭עֹ֣זְבִים אָרְח֣וֹת יֹ֑שֶׁר לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת בְּדַרְכֵי־ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
units.en: from those who abandon upright paths to walk in ways of darkness,
meaningNotes: The plural clauses in this verse and the next describe the evildoers from whom wisdom rescues a person.
displayMeaningNotes: The plural clauses in this verse and the next describe the evildoers from whom wisdom rescues a person.

units.he: הַ֭שְּׂמֵחִים לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת רָ֑ע יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ בְּֽתַהְפֻּכ֥וֹת רָֽע׃
units.en: who rejoice in doing evil and delight in the perversities of evil.

units.he: הֵידֵין תִּתְבַּיֵן צִדְקְתָא וְדִינָא וּתְרִיצוּתָא דְכָל שִׁבְלֵי שַׁפִּירֵי:
units.en: Then you will understand righteousness, judgment, and the uprightness of all good paths.
meaningNotes: This “then” remains the conclusion of the preceding conditional pursuit of wisdom.
displayMeaningNotes: This “then” remains the conclusion of the preceding conditional pursuit of wisdom.

units.he: אֲרֵי תֵעוֹל חָכְמְתָא לְלִבָּךְ וִידִיעֲתָא לְנַפְשָׁךְ יִבְסָם:
units.en: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

units.he: תַּרְעִיתָא תִּנְטוֹר עֲלָךְ בְּיוּנְתָּא תִּנְצְרָךְ:
units.en: Counsel will watch over you; understanding will guard you,

units.he: דִי תִתְפְּצֵי מִן אָרְחָא בִישָׁא וּמִן גַבְרָא דִמְמַלֵל מְפַרְכְיָתָא:
units.en: so that you will be delivered from the evil way and from the man who speaks twisted things,

units.he: דְשָׁבְקִין אָרְחָתָא תְרִיצָתָא וְאָזְלִין בְּאָרְחָתָא דַחֲשׁוֹכָא:
units.en: from those who abandon upright paths and go along ways of darkness,

units.he: דְחָדְיָן לְמֶעְבַּד בִּישׁ וְדִיצִין בְּהוֹפְכָא דְבִישְׁתָּא:
units.en: who rejoice in doing evil and delight in the perversity of evil.

units.he: כֵּיצַד הָרֶגֶל מוּעֶדֶת. לְשַׁבֵּר בְּדֶרֶךְ הִלּוּכָהּ. הַבְּהֵמָה מוּעֶדֶת לְהַלֵּךְ כְּדַרְכָּהּ וּלְשַׁבֵּר. הָיְתָה מְבַעֶטֶת, אוֹ שֶׁהָיוּ צְרוֹרוֹת מְנַתְּזִין מִתַּחַת רַגְלֶיהָ וְשִׁבְּרָה אֶת הַכֵּלִים, מְשַׁלֵּם חֲצִי נֶזֶק. דָּרְסָה עַל הַכְּלִי וְשִׁבְּרַתּוֹ, וְנָפַל עַל כְּלִי וּשְׁבָרוֹ, עַל הָרִאשׁוֹן מְשַׁלֵּם נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם, וְעַל הָאַחֲרוֹן מְשַׁלֵּם חֲצִי נֶזֶק. הַתַּרְנְגוֹלִים מוּעָדִין לְהַלֵּךְ כְּדַרְכָּן וּלְשַׁבֵּר. הָיָה דְלִיל קָשׁוּר בְּרַגְלָיו, אוֹ שֶׁהָיָה מְהַדֵּס וּמְשַׁבֵּר אֶת הַכֵּלִים, מְשַׁלֵּם חֲצִי נֶזֶק:
units.en: In what way is the foot classified as habitually damaging? In breaking things in the course of walking. An animal is considered habitually damaging when it walks normally and breaks things. If it was kicking, or pebbles were flying out from under its feet and it broke vessels, [its owner] pays half the damage. If it trod on a vessel and broke it, and that vessel fell onto another vessel and broke it, he pays full damages for the first and half damages for the last. Fowl are considered habitually damaging when they walk normally and break things. If a cord was tied to its legs, or it was hopping and breaking vessels, he pays half damages.
meaningNotes: “Habitually damaging” is a legal classification for an expected manner of damage, not a claim that the animal has previously damaged property. Indirect pebble damage has its separate half-damages category in the injured party’s domain. The final fowl cases concern indirect damage by objects sent flying; they do not make ordinary direct breakage from hopping subject only to half damages. “Hopping” is one interpretation of מְהַדֵּס; scratching or digging with the feet is another.
displayMeaningNotes: “Habitually damaging” is a legal classification for an expected manner of damage, not a claim that the animal has previously damaged property. Indirect pebble damage has its separate half-damages category in the injured party’s domain. The final fowl cases concern indirect damage by objects sent flying; they do not make ordinary direct breakage from hopping subject only to half damages. “Hopping” is one interpretation of מְהַדֵּס; scratching or digging with the feet is another.

units.he: כֵּיצַד הַשֵּׁן מוּעֶדֶת. לֶאֱכֹל אֶת הָרָאוּי לָהּ. הַבְּהֵמָה מוּעֶדֶת לֶאֱכֹל פֵּרוֹת וִירָקוֹת. אָכְלָה כְסוּת אוֹ כֵלִים, מְשַׁלֵּם חֲצִי נֶזֶק. בַּמֶּה דְבָרִים אֲמוּרִים. בִּרְשׁוּת הַנִּזָּק, אֲבָל בִּרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים, פָּטוּר. אִם נֶהֱנֵית, מְשַׁלֵּם מַה שֶּׁנֶּהֱנֵית. כֵּיצַד מְשַׁלֵּם מַה שֶּׁנֶּהֱנֵית. אָכְלָה מִתּוֹךְ הָרְחָבָה, מְשַׁלֵּם מַה שֶּׁנֶּהֱנֵית. מִצִּדֵּי הָרְחָבָה, מְשַׁלֵּם מַה שֶּׁהִזִּיקָה. מִפֶּתַח הַחֲנוּת, מְשַׁלֵּם מַה שֶּׁנֶּהֱנֵית. מִתּוֹךְ הַחֲנוּת, מְשַׁלֵּם מַה שֶּׁהִזִּיקָה:
units.en: In what way is the tooth classified as habitually damaging? In eating what is suitable for it. An animal is considered habitually damaging when it eats fruit and vegetables. If it ate clothing or vessels, [its owner] pays half damages. Where does this [ordinary-eating rule] apply? In the injured party’s domain; in the public domain, he is exempt. If the animal benefited, he pays the value of its benefit. How does he pay the value of its benefit? If it ate from the open area, he pays the value of its benefit; from the sides of the open area, he pays for what it damaged. From a shop’s entrance, he pays the value of its benefit; from inside the shop, he pays for what it damaged.
meaningNotes: The public-domain exemption concerns ordinary eating of suitable food, not unusual eating of clothing or vessels; the latter carries half-damages liability even in the public domain. Exemption from damage payment does not erase payment for benefit.
displayMeaningNotes: The public-domain exemption concerns ordinary eating of suitable food, not unusual eating of clothing or vessels; the latter carries half-damages liability even in the public domain. Exemption from damage payment does not erase payment for benefit.

units.he: הַכֶּלֶב וְהַגְּדִי שֶׁקָּפְצוּ מֵרֹאשׁ הַגָּג וְשִׁבְּרוּ אֶת הַכֵּלִים, מְשַׁלֵּם נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהֵן מוּעָדִין. הַכֶּלֶב שֶׁנָּטַל חֲרָרָה וְהָלַךְ לַגָּדִישׁ, אָכַל הַחֲרָרָה וְהִדְלִיק הַגָּדִישׁ, עַל הַחֲרָרָה מְשַׁלֵּם נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם, וְעַל הַגָּדִישׁ מְשַׁלֵּם חֲצִי נֶזֶק:
units.en: If a dog or kid jumped from the top of a roof and broke vessels, [its owner] pays full damages, because they are considered habitually damaging in this way. If a dog took a cake, went to a stack of grain, ate the cake, and set the stack on fire, he pays full damages for the cake and half damages for the stack.

units.he: אֵיזֶה הוּא תָם, וְאֵיזֶה הוּא מוּעָד. מוּעָד, כֹּל שֶׁהֵעִידוּ בוֹ שְׁלשָׁה יָמִים. וְתָם, מִשֶּׁיַּחֲזֹר בּוֹ שְׁלשָׁה יָמִים, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יְהוּדָה. רַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹמֵר, מוּעָד, שֶׁהֵעִידוּ בוֹ שָׁלשׁ פְּעָמִים. וְתָם, כֹּל שֶׁיְּהוּ הַתִּינוֹקוֹת מְמַשְׁמְשִׁין בּוֹ וְאֵינוֹ נוֹגֵחַ:
units.en: What animal is classified as not habitually damaging, and what as habitually damaging? Habitually damaging: one against which testimony has been given on three days. Not habitually damaging: one that has reverted [to harmless behavior] for three days. These are the words of Rabbi Yehudah. Rabbi Meir says: Habitually damaging: one against which testimony has been given three times. Not habitually damaging: one that children handle and it does not gore.
meaningNotes: Three days and three occasions are the two speakers’ different tests.
displayMeaningNotes: Three days and three occasions are the two speakers’ different tests.

units.he: שׁוֹר הַמַּזִּיק בִּרְשׁוּת הַנִּזָּק כֵּיצַד. נָגַח, נָגַף, נָשַׁךְ, רָבַץ, בָּעַט, בִּרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים, מְשַׁלֵּם חֲצִי נֶזֶק. בִּרְשׁוּת הַנִּזָּק, רַבִּי טַרְפוֹן אוֹמֵר נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם, וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים חֲצִי נֶזֶק. אָמַר לָהֶם רַבִּי טַרְפוֹן, וּמַה בִּמְקוֹם שֶׁהֵקֵל עַל הַשֵּׁן וְעַל הָרֶגֶל בִּרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים, שֶׁהוּא פָטוּר, הֶחְמִיר עֲלֵיהֶם בִּרְשׁוּת הַנִּזָּק לְשַׁלֵּם נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם, מְקוֹם שֶׁהֶחְמִיר עַל הַקֶּרֶן בִּרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים, לְשַׁלֵּם חֲצִי נֶזֶק, אֵינוֹ דִין שֶׁנַּחְמִיר עָלֶיהָ בִּרְשׁוּת הַנִּזָּק לְשַׁלֵּם נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם. אָמְרוּ לוֹ, דַּיּוֹ לַבָּא מִן הַדִּין לִהְיוֹת כַּנִּדּוֹן, מַה בִרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים חֲצִי נֶזֶק, אַף בִּרְשׁוּת הַנִּזָּק חֲצִי נֶזֶק. אָמַר לָהֶם, אֲנִי לֹא אָדוּן קֶרֶן מִקֶּרֶן, אֲנִי אָדוּן קֶרֶן מֵרֶגֶל. וּמַה בִמְקוֹם שֶׁהֵקֵל עַל הַשֵּׁן וְעַל הָרֶגֶל, בִּרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים, הֶחְמִיר בַּקֶּרֶן, מְקוֹם שֶׁהֶחְמִיר עַל הַשֵּׁן וְעַל הָרֶגֶל, בִּרְשׁוּת הַנִּזָּק, אֵינוֹ דִין שֶׁנַּחְמִיר בַּקֶּרֶן. אָמְרוּ לוֹ, דַּיּוֹ לַבָּא מִן הַדִּין לִהְיוֹת כַּנִּדּוֹן, מַה בִּרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים חֲצִי נֶזֶק, אַף בִּרְשׁוּת הַנִּזָּק חֲצִי נֶזֶק:
units.en: What is the case of an ox that causes damage in the injured party’s domain? If it gored, pushed, bit, lay down on something, or kicked in the public domain, [its owner] pays half damages. In the injured party’s domain, Rabbi Tarfon says: Full damages; the Sages say: Half damages. Rabbi Tarfon said to them: Where [the law] was lenient regarding tooth and foot in the public domain, making [the owner] exempt, it was stringent regarding them in the injured party’s domain, requiring full damages. Where it was stringent regarding horn in the public domain, requiring half damages, is it not logical to be stringent regarding it in the injured party’s domain, requiring full damages? They said to him: It is enough for what is derived by an inference to be like the case from which it is derived: just as in the public domain [horn requires] half damages, so too in the injured party’s domain, half damages. He said to them: I do not infer horn from horn; I infer horn from foot. Where [the law] was lenient regarding tooth and foot in the public domain, it was stringent regarding horn. Where it was stringent regarding tooth and foot, in the injured party’s domain, is it not logical to be stringent regarding horn? They said to him: It is enough for what is derived by an inference to be like the case from which it is derived: just as in the public domain [horn requires] half damages, so too in the injured party’s domain, half damages.
meaningNotes: “Horn,” “tooth,” and “foot” are categories of animal damage. This case concerns an ox in the not-habitually-damaging category. Rabbi Tarfon offers two inferential arguments, and the Sages answer each by limiting the inferred rule to its precedent.
displayMeaningNotes: “Horn,” “tooth,” and “foot” are categories of animal damage. This case concerns an ox in the not-habitually-damaging category. Rabbi Tarfon offers two inferential arguments, and the Sages answer each by limiting the inferred rule to its precedent.

units.he: אָדָם מוּעָד לְעוֹלָם, בֵּין שׁוֹגֵג, בֵּין מֵזִיד, בֵּין עֵר, בֵּין יָשֵׁן. סִמֵּא אֶת עֵין חֲבֵרוֹ וְשִׁבֵּר אֶת הַכֵּלִים, מְשַׁלֵּם נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם:
units.en: A person is always classified as habitually damaging, whether acting unintentionally or intentionally, awake or asleep. If he blinded another person’s eye or broke vessels, he pays full damages.

units.he: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: תַּרְנְגוֹלִין שֶׁהָיוּ מַפְרִיחִין מִמָּקוֹם לְמָקוֹם, וְשָׁבְרוּ כֵּלִים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶן – מְשַׁלֵּם נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם. בְּרוּחַ שֶׁבְּכַנְפֵיהֶן – מְשַׁלְּמִין חֲצִי נֶזֶק. סוֹמְכוֹס אוֹמֵר: נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם. תַּנְיָא אִידַּךְ: תַּרְנְגוֹלִין שֶׁהָיוּ מְהַדְּסִין עַל גַּבֵּי עִיסָּה וְעַל גַּבֵּי פֵּירוֹת, וְטִינְּפוּ אוֹ נִיקְּרוּ – מְשַׁלֵּם נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם. הֶעֱלוּ עָפָר אוֹ צְרוֹרוֹת – מְשַׁלְּמִין חֲצִי נֶזֶק. סוֹמְכוֹס אוֹמֵר: נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם.
units.en: The Rabbis taught: If chickens fly from place to place and break utensils with their wings, full damages are paid. If they break them with the wind of their wings, half damages are paid. Sumakhos says: Full damages. Another teaching states: If chickens move about on dough or fruit and soil or peck it, full damages are paid. If they throw up dust or pebbles, half damages are paid. Sumakhos says: Full damages.

units.he: תַּנְיָא אִידַּךְ: תַּרְנְגוֹל שֶׁהָיָה מַפְרִיחַ מִמָּקוֹם לְמָקוֹם, וְיָצְתָה רוּחַ מִתַּחַת כְּנָפָיו וְשִׁיבְּרָה אֶת הַכֵּלִים – מְשַׁלֵּם חֲצִי נֶזֶק. סְתָמָא כְּרַבָּנַן.
units.en: Another teaching states: If a chicken flies from place to place and a gust comes from beneath its wings and breaks utensils, half damages are paid. This unattributed teaching follows the Rabbis.

units.he: תַּנְיָא כְּוָתֵיהּ דְּרָבָא: בְּהֵמָה מוּעֶדֶת לְשַׁבֵּר בְּדֶרֶךְ הִלּוּכָהּ. כֵּיצַד? בְּהֵמָה שֶׁנִּכְנְסָה לַחֲצַר הַנִּיזָּק – וְהִזִּיקָה בְּגוּפָהּ דֶּרֶךְ הִלּוּכָהּ, וּבִשְׂעָרָהּ דֶּרֶךְ הִלּוּכָהּ; בָּאוּכָּף שֶׁעָלֶיהָ, וּבִשְׁלִיף שֶׁעָלֶיהָ, וּבִפְרוּמְבְּיָא שֶׁבְּפִיהָ, וּבְזוֹג שֶׁבְּצַוָּארָהּ; וַחֲמוֹר בְּמַשָּׂאוֹ, וְעֶגְלָה מוֹשֶׁכֶת בְּקָרוֹן – מְשַׁלֵּם נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם.
units.en: A teaching supports Rava: An animal is regarded as forewarned regarding breakage in the course of walking. How so? If an animal enters the injured party’s courtyard and causes damage with its body in the course of walking, or with its hair in the course of walking; with the saddle upon it, the load upon it, the bridle in its mouth, or the bell at its neck; or if a donkey causes damage with its load, or a heifer draws a wagon—full damages are paid.

units.he: פאות הזקן הם ה׳ ורבו בהם הדיעות לפיכך ירא שמים יצא את כולם ולא יעביר תער על כל זקנו כלל:
units.en: There are five corners of the beard, and opinions concerning them are numerous. Therefore, a person who fears Heaven should satisfy all the opinions and not pass a razor over any part of his beard at all.
displayMeaningNotes: This daily excerpt is not the complete legal subsection or all Rema glosses, and is not a personal practical ruling.

units.he: צריך להזהר שלא ידור שום נדר ואפי׳ צדקה אין טוב לידור אלא אם ישנו בידו יתן מיד:
units.en: One must take care not to make any vow. Even for charity it is not good to vow; rather, if he has the means in hand, he should give immediately.
displayMeaningNotes: This daily excerpt is not the complete legal subsection or all Rema glosses, and is not a personal practical ruling.

units.he: כל איש ישראל חייב בתלמוד תורה בין עני בין עשיר בין שלם בגופו בין בעל יסורים בין בחור בין זקן גדול אפי׳ עני המחזר על הפתחים אפי׳ אם הוא בעל אשה ובנים חייב לקבוע לו זמן לתלמוד תורה ביום ובלילה שנאמר והגית בו יומם ולילה:
units.en: Every Jewish man is obligated in Torah study: poor or rich, physically sound or afflicted, young or very old. Even a poor person who goes from door to door, and even a man who has a wife and children, must set aside time for Torah study by day and by night, as it is said, ‘You shall meditate on it day and night.’
displayMeaningNotes: This daily excerpt is not the complete legal subsection or all Rema glosses, and is not a personal practical ruling. Yoreh De’ah 246:1 also contains constrained-circumstance provisions and support for others’ study, which this compilation omits. The abridged statement does not establish that those legal branches are absent.

units.he: עד אימתי חייב ללמוד עד יום מותו:
units.en: Until when must he study? Until the day of his death.

units.he: תחילת דינו של אדם על ת״ת ואח״כ על שאר מעשיו:
units.en: A person is first judged regarding Torah study, and afterward regarding his other deeds.

units.he:
אמר רבי יהודה, אף על גב דזכאה הוה נח, לאו איהו כדאי (בגין) דקב"ה יגין על עלמא בגיניה, תא חזי, משה לא תלה מלה בזכותיה אלא בזכות אבהן קדמאי, אבל נח לא הוה ליה במאן דיתלי בזכותא כמשה, אמר רבי יצחק, ועם כל דא כיון דאמר ליה קב"ה והקימותי את בריתי אתך, הוה ליה למבעי רחמי עלייהו, וקרבנא דאקריב לבתר, דיקריב ליה מן קדמת דנא, דלמא ישכך רוגזא מעלמא, אמר רבי יהודה, מאי הוה ליה למעבד, דהא חייבי עלמא הוו מרגיזין קמי קב"ה ואיהו יקריב קרבנא, אלא ודאי נח דחיל על גרמיה הוה, בגין דלא יערע ביה מותא בגו חייבי עלמא, דהוה חמי עובדיהון בישא כל יומא, והיך מרגזן קמי קב"ה כל יומא. 

רבי (אלעזר פתח) יצחק אמר, כל זמנא דחייבי עלמא אסגיאו, זכאה דאשתכח בינייהו הוא אתפס בקדמיתא, דכתיב (יחזקאל ט ו) וממקדשי תחלו, ותנינן אל תקרי ממקדשי, אלא ממקודשי, ונח היך שזיב ליה קב"ה בין כל אינון חייביא, אלא בגין דיפקון מניה תולדין בעלמא, דהוה צדיק כדקא יאות, ותו דאיהו אתרי בהו כל יומא ויומא ולא קבילו מניה, וקיים בנפשיה קרא דכתיב (שם ג יט) ואתה כי הזהרת רשע וגו', וכתיב ואתה את נפשך הצלת, מכאן כל מאן דאזהר לחייבא אע"ג דלא קביל מניה, הוא שזיב ליה לגרמיה, וההוא חייבא אתפס בחוביה, ועד כמה יזהר ליה, עד דימחי ליה, הא אוקמוה חבריא.
units.en:
Rabbi Yehudah said: Although Noach was righteous, he was not worthy (on account of) [that righteousness] for the Holy One, blessed be He, to protect the world on his account. Come and see: Moshe did not base the matter on his own merit, but on the merit of the early patriarchs. Noach, however, had no one on whose merit to rely as Moshe did. Rabbi Yitzchak said: Yet, since the Holy One, blessed be He, said to him, “I will establish My covenant with you,” he should have sought mercy for them. And the offering that he brought afterward—he should have brought it beforehand; perhaps the wrath would have subsided from the world. Rabbi Yehudah said: What could he have done? For the guilty people of the world were provoking the Holy One, blessed be He, and was he to bring an offering? Rather, certainly, Noach was afraid for himself, so that death would not strike him among the guilty people of the world, for he saw their evil deeds every day, and how they provoked the Holy One, blessed be He, every day.

Rabbi (Elazar opened) Yitzchak said: Whenever the guilty people of the world multiply, the righteous person found among them is seized first, as it is written: “Begin from My sanctuary” (Ezekiel 9:6). We have learned: Do not read “from My sanctuary” (ממקדשי), but “from My sanctified ones” (ממקודשי). How, then, did the Holy One, blessed be He, save Noach among all those guilty people? Rather, because offspring were to come forth from him in the world, for he was properly righteous; and also because he warned them each and every day, and they did not accept it from him. He fulfilled in his own person the verse that is written: “And you, when you have warned a wicked person,” etc. (Ezekiel 3:19); and it is written: “You have saved your own soul.” From here [we learn]: anyone who warns a guilty person, even though that person does not accept it from him, saves himself, while that guilty person is seized for his own sin. And how far should he go in warning him? Until [the guilty person] strikes him. The companions have already explained this.
displayMeaningNotes: Rabbi Yehudah and Rabbi Yitzchak express differing views about Noach, prayer and the timing of his offering. The parenthetical בגין concerns his righteousness and protection of the world.
The speaker line contains the alternate parenthetical opening אלעזר פתח. The sanctuary/sanctified-ones wordplay depends on the Hebrew forms ממקדשי and ממקודשי.

“Seized” refers to punishment in the passage, not private punishment. The guilty person is the supplied subject of “strikes him”; the passage discusses the extent of warning, not an instruction to strike the person being warned.

units.he: צריך לירא מלפגום כי שבעה המה עיני ה׳ משוטטות הם מעידים על פגם הנעשה שבהם מצטייר הכל כמו שאמר הכתוב והרע בעיניך עשיתי. עוד מסוג זה שהוא מכניס הסמאל״ל הטמא בין הקדושים הלא יאמרו מי גרם שיכנס המצורע הזה בינינו הלא ודאי יענש. בפרט המדבר לשון הרע הוא הגורם הגדול שמיד סמאל״ל עולה. ושני המלאכים ההולכים עם האדם הם בדלים ממנו והם אבלים עליו עד שובו שנאמר ואשלם נחומים לו ולאבליו. ויתן אל לבו לשוב שלא יהיו המלאכים אבלים עליו. וכאשר האדם חוטא התורה באה ורושמת החטא בפניו וכל צבאות מעלה בהיות הרושם ההוא בפניו מקללים אותו ונבדלים ממנו כי רוח הטומאה שורה עליו. ואמרו זכרונם לברכה כי כדי להעביר הרושם צריך שיבכה וירחץ בדמעות פניו. וטוב להעביר הדמעות על מצחו כי במצח נכתמים העונות. ותהיה כונתו בהתודותו באלפא ביתא אשמנו בגדנו גזלנו וכו׳ לטהר כ״ב אותיות הפגומים בעונותיו. ולקבל עליו גזרת הדין לטהר המדות וזהו ואתה צדיק על כל הבא עלינו וכו׳. וצריך שיסתכל כי שמא כשחטא היה העולם חציו זכאי וחציו חייב ובעונותיו הכריע העולם לכף חובה. וכמה עניים צועקים ברעה שהוא עשה שהכריע העולם לכף חובה. וכלל הפגמים האלה כלל רבי שמעון בן יוחאי עליו השלום בדברים קצרים מאן דעבר על פקודי אורייתא כביכול פגים לעילא ופגים לתתא פגים לגרמיה לכל עלמין:
units.en:
A person must fear causing damage, for ‘these seven are the eyes of ה׳, ranging about.’ They testify to the damage that is done, for everything is depicted in them, as Scripture says: ‘And what is evil in Your eyes I have done.’ Of this same kind is his bringing the impure הסמאל״ל among the holy beings. Will they not say: ‘Who caused this leper to enter among us? Surely he will be punished!’ In particular, one who speaks malicious gossip is the principal cause, for סמאל״ל immediately ascends. The two angels who accompany a person separate from him and mourn for him until he returns, as it is said: ‘I shall restore consolations to him and to his mourners.’ He should take it to heart to return, so that the angels will not mourn for him.

When a person sins, the Torah comes and inscribes the sin on his face. All the heavenly hosts, while that mark is on his face, curse him and separate from him, because the spirit of impurity rests upon him. They, of blessed memory, said that to remove the mark he must weep and wash his face with his tears. It is good to pass the tears over his forehead, for sins leave stains on the forehead. His intention when confessing in alphabetical order—‘We have incurred guilt. We have betrayed. We have robbed,’ etc.—should be to purify the twenty-two letters blemished by his sins, and to accept upon himself the decree of judgment, to purify the attributes. This is the meaning of ‘And You are righteous concerning all that has come upon us,’ etc.

He must consider that perhaps, when he sinned, the world was half meritorious and half guilty, and through his sins he tipped the world toward the scale of guilt. How many poor people cry out in the calamity that he caused by tipping the world toward the scale of guilt! The teacher Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai, peace be upon him, encompassed all these kinds of damage in a few words: ‘One who transgresses the commandments of the Torah, as it were, damages above and damages below, damages himself and all the worlds.’

meaningNotes.he: הפתיחה נשענת על זכריה ד:י; ״והרע בעיניך עשיתי״ הוא תהלים נא:ו. ״המצורע״ הוא כאן דימוי לטומאה הנכנסת בין הקדושים, ולא פסיקה רפואית או הוראה לביזוי אדם חולה. ״ואשלם נחומים לו ולאבליו״ הוא ישעיה נז:יח.
meaningNotes.en: The opening draws on Zechariah 4:10; ‘And what is evil in Your eyes I have done’ is Tehillim 51:6. The leper is an image here of impurity entering among the holy beings, not a medical ruling or an instruction to demean a sick person. ‘I shall restore consolations to him and to his mourners’ is Yeshaya 57:18.

meaningNotes.he: הסמאל״ל וסמאל״ל הם שני אזכורים של הכינוי המלאכי שבקטע. הם מתארים את הכוח הטמא הנכנס בין הקדושים ועולה בעקבות לשון הרע. בהמשך, פרישת המלאכים והאבל נמשכים עד שיבת האדם בתשובה.
meaningNotes.en: הסמאל״ל and סמאל״ל are two occurrences of the angelic designation in this passage. They describe the impure power that enters among the holy beings and ascends following malicious gossip. In the continuation, the angels’ separation and mourning last until the person returns in repentance.

meaningNotes.he: הווידוי מסודר באלף־בית, ומכאן הקשר לכ״ב אותיות. ״ואתה צדיק על כל הבא עלינו״ נשען על נחמיה ט:לג ומשמש בווידוי: קבלת הדין נקשרת כאן לטיהור המידות.
meaningNotes.en: The confession is arranged alphabetically, hence the connection with the twenty-two letters. ‘And You are righteous concerning all that has come upon us’ draws on Nehemiah 9:33 and is used in confession: accepting judgment is linked here with purifying the attributes.

meaningNotes.he: המשפט על הכרעת העולם נשאר מותנה: שמא העולם היה מחצה זכאי ומחצה חייב בשעת החטא. זו התבוננות באחריות המעשה, ולא קביעה שאפשר לזהות אדם מסוים כסיבת אסון מסוים. ״כביכול״ מסייג את לשון הפגם במדרגות העליונות.
meaningNotes.en: The statement about tipping the world remains conditional: perhaps the world was equally balanced between merit and guilt when the sin occurred. This is reflection on responsibility for one's actions, not a claim that a particular person can be identified as the cause of a particular calamity. ‘As it were’ qualifies the language of damage to the supernal levels.
